source.name: City of Calgary Open Data · Building Permits
source.licence: Open Government Licence – City of Calgary

sources.name: raw_permits
sources.description: Permit records exactly as the City's API returns them. Every field is text.

models.name: stg_permits
models.description: Typed, renamed and deduplicated. Zero coordinates become NULL. One row per permit, latest version wins.
models.sql:
select
    permitnum                                              as permit_id,
    cast(cast(applieddate as timestamp) as date)           as applied_date,
    cast(try_cast(issueddate as timestamp) as date)        as issued_date,
    cast(try_cast(completeddate as timestamp) as date)     as completed_date,
    statuscurrent                                          as status,
    permittypemapped                                       as permit_type,
    permitclassmapped                                      as permit_class,
    permitclassgroup                                       as class_group,
    workclassgroup                                         as work_group,
    coalesce(try_cast(housingunits as integer), 0)         as housing_units,
    try_cast(estprojectcost as double)                     as est_cost,
    try_cast(totalsqft as double)                          as sqft,
    communityname                                          as community,
    nullif(round(try_cast(latitude as double), 4), 0)      as lat,
    nullif(round(try_cast(longitude as double), 4), 0)     as lon,
    try_cast(source_updated_at as timestamp)               as updated_at
from {{ ref('raw_permits') }}
where permitnum is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by permitnum order by source_updated_at desc) = 1

models.name: permits
models.description: Applications since 2015, ready for analysis. Served to the browser as Parquet.
models.sql:
select *
from {{ ref('stg_permits') }}
where applied_date >= date '2015-01-01'
order by applied_date, permit_id

tests.name: permit_class is a known value
tests.description: Catches a new category upstream before it silently drops out of charts.
tests.sql:
select count(*) as failures from (
with all_values as (

    select
        permit_class as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from {{ ref('permits') }}
    group by permit_class

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'Residential','Non-Residential','Unspecified'
)
) dbt_test

tests.name: work_group is a known value
tests.description: Same guard for the work type.
tests.sql:
select count(*) as failures from (
with all_values as (

    select
        work_group as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from {{ ref('permits') }}
    group by work_group

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'New','Improvement','Demolition','Unspecified'
)
) dbt_test

tests.name: Completed on or after issued
tests.description: Upstream date entry issue. Flagged so time-to-complete metrics can exclude them.

tests.name: housing_units is between 0 and 2,000
tests.description: A negative or huge unit count is a data entry error, not a building.

tests.name: Issued on or after applied
tests.description: A permit can't be issued before it's applied for. Flagged, not dropped.

tests.name: Coordinates fall inside Calgary
tests.description: Swapped or mistyped coordinates would put permits in another city.

tests.name: applied_date is never null
tests.description: Every permit has an application date.

tests.name: Coordinates are present
tests.description: Some permits have no location. They stay in totals but can't be mapped.

tests.name: permit_id is never null
Source updated in the last 8 days
tests.description: If the City stops publishing, the refresh fails instead of serving stale data quietly.

tests.name: At least 200,000 rows
tests.description: Guards against a partial extract replacing the full table.

tests.name: permit_id is unique
tests.sql:
select count(*) as failures from (
select
    permit_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from {{ ref('permits') }}
where permit_id is not null
group by permit_id
having count(*) > 1
) dbt_test

contract.cadence: Weekly, Mondays at 10:00 UTC, via Airflow on GitHub Actions
guarantees: permit_id is unique and never null.
Dates are DATE values. No timestamps, no time zones.
A failing error-level test blocks the refresh. The last good snapshot keeps serving.
Schema changes land in this repo, reviewed, before they ship.
